answer: Sybil resistance rests on a bond that is slashed, never refunded. A new account stakes in proportion to the square of its claimed standing, so clones pay the same capital as one honest node yet spread it over more challengeable claims. On a lost dispute the bond burns and the identity is ejected: funding N clones loses N bonds, while a challenger pays one dispute fee. Reputation comes only from verdict-matched work, so clones start at zero weight. Honest stake returns after cooldown, making the economy an oasis for real work, a meadow cleared of duplicates where a lotus cannot be copied free.
